question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Sudhir's harrassment is not only perceivable and occasional but also has become a matter of humorous incident before his colleague.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "harrassment."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'harassment.'
 
• 'Harassment' means 'behaviour that annoys or upsets someone.' (व्यवहार जो किसी को परेशान या परेशान करता है)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Prisoners' families face continual **harassment** and attack.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'harrassment' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's know the meaning of the other options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 colleague
 one of a group of people who work together. (एक साथ काम करने वाले लोगों के समूह में से एक)
 
 

 humorous
 the ability to find things funny. ( हास्यकर)
 
 

 perceivable
 to come to an opinion about something, or have a belief about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में कोई राय रखना)
